name: oxide-sloc
description: Fast offline source-lines-of-code and complexity metrics, written in Rust. Ships prebuilt, statically-linked binaries for Windows and Linux, so it needs no toolchain or network to run. Use 'Unpack prebuilt binary' once, then Run.

commands.label: Unpack prebuilt binary (enables Run)
commands.help: Extract the shipped oxide-sloc binary from dist/ into dist/ so Run and the commands below can execute it. Uses the tar that ships with Windows 10+ and Linux.

commands.label: Version
commands.help: Print the oxide-sloc version (run 'Unpack prebuilt binary' first).
